title: fix(spec)!: a datasource named `drivers` is refused at every door that parses a datasource
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VET38SionkCZ9btiotp9jr)_
Fixes #29308

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none in `skills/**` (`skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md` teaches `default` as host-reserved, and no file under `skills/**` declares or shows a datasource named `drivers`; every taught use stays true). Docs: `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx` said `drivers` was reserved at the admin API only; it now names the schema refusal and every door.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据源名 `drivers` 现在在所有解析数据源的入口被拒收(代码声明、`os validate`、元数据保存门 422),不再只在管理接口的新建门拒收;保留名单搬进 spec,成为唯一一份,管理接口的路由和新建门都读它。
- 为什么改:`GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` 是驱动目录,叫 `drivers` 的数据源永远打不开编辑页;新建门拦住了,但代码和元数据保存门还能造出这个打不开的数据源。
- 风险与回滚:收窄,叫 `drivers` 的数据源再保存会被拒;仓内作者写的此名数据源为 0。已存的行照常加载,`_diagnostics` 标 `valid: false`,管理接口里仍可列出、删除、只改标签。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`(新常量与 `name` 上的第二条 pattern)、`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-route-reserved-names.ts`(改读 spec 常量)、迁移条目 `18.datasource-name-route-shadowed-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/datasource-route-shadowed-name.test.ts`,预期 7 项全绿,其中一项断言报错落在 `name`、以 `Datasource name 'drivers' is reserved` 开头。
- 需要你做的:新公开导出名 `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` 需要你点头(席位会问);其余无,席位落地(落地前走一次契约复核)。

## What changes

- **One list, in the spec.** New export `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` in `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), a frozen `['drivers'] as const`: the names the datasource admin API can never serve by name, because a literal route under `/api/v1/datasources/` shares a method with the by-name read and is mounted ahead of it (`GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` is the driver catalog).
- **`DatasourceSchema.name` refuses each entry.** A second `.regex()` on `name` (a negative lookahead built from the list), with the message `Datasource name 'drivers' is reserved: the datasource admin API serves its own route at /api/v1/datasources/drivers, ahead of the by-name read /api/v1/datasources/:name, so a datasource of that name could never be read by name. Pick another name.` One `invalid_format` issue at `name`. A pattern, not a refinement: zod emits both patterns into the published JSON Schema (`allOf`), so no `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` row is added (the build reads 988 sites before and after) and JSON-Schema consumers refuse the name too (pinned).
- **The admin routes read the spec list** (the one declared cross-lane file, `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-route-reserved-names.ts`). `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` there is now the spec's frozen array itself (widened to `readonly string[]` for the create door's `includes`), and `DRIVER_CATALOG_SEGMENT`, the segment the registrar mounts the catalog from, is typed `(typeof ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES)[number]` against the spec list, so a catalog segment the spec does not reserve does not compile. The registrar (`admin-routes.ts`) and the create door (`datasource-admin-service.ts`) are unchanged: they already imported from this file.
- **Create door: no double refusal.** `createDatasource` runs `assertValidName` (which refuses `drivers` with its own 400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` sentence) before any schema parse, so a `POST /api/v1/datasources` for `drivers` still answers that one refusal; the existing door pins hold unchanged (below).
- **Semantic migration entry** `datasource-name-route-shadowed-refused` (step 18), modelled on `stack-datasource-host-reserved-name-refused`: refused with a prescription, no conversion (the new name, and every object that routes to it, are the author's call).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`: the sentence PR #29262 added ("reserved at the datasource admin API") now names the schema refusal and every door. Regenerated: `content/docs/references/data/datasource.mdx`, `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`.
- **Not changed.** `default` (the host's own `default` row still parses through `DatasourceSchema`; a stack still may not declare it, `stack.zod.ts`), `test` (the draft-probe literal shadows no by-name read), and names that only contain the word (`driver`, `drivers_archive`, `my_drivers`, `_drivers`), all pinned as controls.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/datasource-route-shadowed-name.test.ts` (7 cases): the list is frozen and every entry matches the identifier pattern (so the refusal pattern needs no escaping); `DatasourceSchema` refuses each entry with one `invalid_format` issue at `name` whose message names the name and the route and carries no tracker number; `defineStack` refuses it with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 at `datasources.0.name`; the published JSON Schema's `name` patterns reject each entry and accept `reporting`, `drivers_archive`, `driver`; controls parse.
- Forced test edits: **none.** `packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-route-reserved-names.test.ts` (the drift pin and the door cases) is unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Save door, measured before and after** (one-shot probe, a scratch `saveMetaItem` test over the stub-engine harness of `protocol.code-defined-datasource-door.test.ts`, both kernel shapes; not committed). Before (`eef116e4`): `PUT datasource/drivers` saved (`success: true`, row stored), and a stored `drivers` row read `_diagnostics.valid: true`. After (`4df813f3`): `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 with `datasource/drivers failed spec validation: name: Datasource name 'drivers' is reserved: …`, nothing stored; the control `drivers_ok` saves; a stored `drivers` row still loads with `_diagnostics: { valid: false, errors: [{ path: 'name', code: 'invalid_format', … }] }`.
- **Admin door on a stored `drivers` row** (written before PR #29262): list, `label`/`active`-only PATCH and DELETE still work (the existing pin). A PATCH that touches `config`, `driver`, `pool` or `external`, or carries a secret, is judged against the whole `DatasourceSchema` (`assertValidRecord`) and is now refused with the schema's sentence: the row has to be renamed, which only a new datasource plus re-pointing the objects can do. Same posture as every other spec refusal on a stored row.
- **Blast radius: 0.** `git grep` for a datasource named `drivers` across `examples/`, `packages/**` (templates, fixtures), `ui/`, `apps/`, `content/`: one hit, the service-datasource stored-row fixture above.
- **New public name for the maintainer**: `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` (the name the service-datasource module already used). Open question in the report.
- `packages/lint` does not validate datasource names (`git grep DatasourceSchema packages/lint/src`: 0 hits), so it owes no reading.

## Verification

All readings at head `4df813f3` (the last commit), tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, each through `os-verify-lock` (VERDICT `command-exit 0` on every line).

- Closure build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' --filter '@objectstack/service-datasource...' --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol...' build`, exit 0 (386 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 792 passed (792), Tests 23398 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 1160 passed (1160), the unchanged `datasource-route-reserved-names.test.ts` among them. Typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 303 passed, 4 skipped (307), Tests 22136 passed, 26 skipped.
- Full dogfood (narrowing arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path: Test Files 393 passed, 3 skipped (396), Tests 3243 passed, 28 skipped (3271), exit 0 (29 m).
